# ComfyUI on RunPod: field notes

> Operational knowledge for ComfyUI video/image generation (LTX-2.3,
> LTX-2.5, FLUX.1/2, Wan 2.2) on RunPod GPU pods with network volumes:
> a symptom-indexed pitfall catalog, validated recipes, and small
> dependency-free scripts.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): architecture pattern, recipes, script index
- [PITFALLS](PITFALLS.md): 20 symptom-indexed failure modes with fixes —
  black-frames-with-success-status, silent text-encoder weight-mismatch,
  UI-to-API widget misfill (batch_size), CFG-1 negative prompts inert,
  bundled-model shadowing, dynamic-VRAM truncation, RunPod GraphQL and
  S3 API quirks
- [SKILL](SKILL.md): the same knowledge as an installable agent skill

## Scripts (Python stdlib only)

- [check-output.py](scripts/check-output.py): content gate for outputs
  (PASS / BLACK / BAD)
- [runpod-volume-s3.py](scripts/runpod-volume-s3.py): manage a RunPod
  network volume via its S3-compatible API, no pod required
- [ui2api.py](scripts/ui2api.py): ComfyUI UI-graph to API-prompt
  converter with widget lint
- [patch-ltxvideo-pad-shim.py](scripts/patch-ltxvideo-pad-shim.py):
  fix ComfyUI-LTXVideo's kornia pad import
